name: sol10-regression-labels
goal: Preserve historical fix labels and side-bound commit links through ComparePanes.

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: ComparePanes migration 59d0e6edec replaced Before fix and After fix status labels with generic side headings. Normal record 55769f56 fails the existing Desktop regression history flow before repair.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the bug; name the scenario, fixture, lifecycle or assertion gap and reusable test change.
steps.evidence: The existing registered runtime-evidence-ui review catches the changed wording, but was pending during fixture-only checks. Strengthen its same history flow with side-scoped commit-link assertions and retain all cases and viewports.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
